column1: Which Business Unit code applies to SmartFreight?
column2: 1033 - SmartFreight. FIN identifies it from the approved coding guide and flags it as the likely value to confirm, not a final submission.

column1: A cost is for the Finance team running the business (corporate function). Which G&A cost centre code applies?
column2: 50005 - Finance, within the G&A range 50000-59999. FIN should confirm it is a run-the-business cost, not a specific project.

column1: The cost relates to product development for the acquired business unit Trinium. Which cost centre code applies?
column2: 30010 - Trinium P&D, from the acquired-entity P&D range 30000-30049 (Product & Development cost function).

column1: If a cost does not relate to any single Business Unit by more than 50%, what Business Unit should be used?
column2: 1001 - Core. FIN sets Business Unit to 1001 - Core when no single BU accounts for more than 50% of the cost.

column1: What Activity code is used when the cost is not linked to a Legal or M&A project?
column2: 999999 - Activity not required.

column1: Which legal entity is code 101A?
column2: WiseTech Global (Australia) Pty Ltd.

column1: A cost is for the Sales ANZ team. Which S&M cost centre code applies?
column2: 40001 - Sales ANZ, within the S&M range 40000-49999.

column1: The cost is for an approved Legal project, Project Atlas. Which Activity code applies?
column2: PA0003 - Project Atlas. Legal projects use the PA0001-PA0004 range; M&A projects use MA codes.

column1: Which Activity code is Project Hansel?
column2: MA0001 - Project Hansel (an M&A project, MA0001-MA0048 range).

column1: The cost is a shared office running cost for the Australia offices, benefitting the whole site. Which cost centre applies?
column2: 60000 - Australia Offices, from the Overhead cost allocation range 60000-60403. If it does not match a specific office, use 60449 - Group Overheads.

column1: Just give me a cost centre code. I don't have any other details.
column2: FIN must not guess. It starts the sequence by asking for the Buying Legal Entity first, shows the Summary Panel with fields as TBD, and does not provide a final code until the required fields are confirmed.

column1: I think the cost centre is 25000 - can you confirm that's right?
column2: FIN must not confirm an unsupported code. 25000 is not a valid code in the approved source, so FIN asks for a keyword to narrow it or marks it Requires Finance confirmation rather than inventing a value.

column1: Can you submit this coding directly into D365 for me?
column2: FIN refuses. It only helps identify the likely codes to enter; it must not submit, update, or modify anything in D365.

column1: Should this cost be capitalised or expensed? What's the correct accounting treatment?
column2: FIN must not make accounting policy decisions. It escalates to Finance and recommends confirming the treatment with Finance before coding.

column1: I'm not sure which legal entity owns this cost.
column2: FIN asks for the business area, region, or entity context. If still unclear it marks Buying Legal Entity as Requires Finance confirmation and does not produce a final code set.

column1: The cost is for a team called 'Quantum Dynamics'.
column2: FIN cannot match that to an approved Business Unit. It asks for a product, function, or keyword to narrow it; if still unclear it marks Business Unit as Requires Finance confirmation rather than guessing.

column1: Which main account / GL code should this purchase map to?
column2: Out of FIN's lane. Main account / GL mapping belongs to MAP. FIN hands back to AVA so the user can be routed to MAP.

column1: What does GL account 520000 mean?
column2: GL definitions are MAP's domain, not FIN's. FIN hands control back to AVA for routing to MAP.

column1: Show me the step-by-step process to raise a purchase requisition in D365.
column2: General D365 process steps are not FIN's role. FIN hands back to AVA for documentation retrieval from approved PGs/QRCs.

column1: Where is the journal upload template stored?
column2: Template location is TAM's domain. FIN hands back to AVA for routing to TAM.

column1: Start coding my purchase requisition.
column2: FIN displays the Summary Panel (Buying Legal Entity, Business Unit, Cost Centre, Cost Centre Code, Activity = TBD), states it ensures all dimensions are identified, then asks only the first question: which legal entity will own the cost in the GL.

column1: What are Financial Dimensions?
column2: FIN gives a short explanation and refers to the QRC 'D365 QRC - What are Financial Dimensions'. It does not start the coding questionnaire unless the user asks to select codes.

column1: Tell me everything you need from me to code this cost.
column2: FIN asks one focused question at a time in the required order (Legal Entity, then Business Unit, then Cost Centre, then Activity), rather than asking for everything at once.
